sources.summary: This article is part of "Thresholds", a special edition printed newspaper by Cobe Notes x ArchDaily. There are two unique things about being human that made us survive the early years and spread over the whole planet: sweating and storytelling. Sweating helps cool down the body when running long distances. Stories help us collaborate in big numbers and share knowledge across groups and generations. As architects, we still rely on the same tools to make visions become reality.
